clubIntro: Register your club's referees or new candidates for courses here. The course fee is invoiced to the club.
onlyOwn: Only courses of my state association
noOffers: There are currently no courses open for registration.
full: fully booked, registration goes on the waiting list
feeOnlyOnLicense: only charged if a license is granted
registered: Registered. A confirmation is sent by e-mail.
waitlisted: The course is full, the registration is on the waiting list.
pendingGuardian: Registered. The parents or guardians receive an e-mail and must consent before the registration is valid.
confirmCancelLate: The cancellation deadline has passed, the course fee remains due. Deregister from „{{course}}“ anyway?
late: after the cancellation deadline, fee due
guardianHint: The person is under 16 on the first course day. The parents or guardians receive an e-mail and must consent before the registration is valid.

consent.title: Consent to course registration
consent.intro: {{name}} has been registered for the referee course „{{course}}“.
consent.text: By clicking you consent, as parent or guardian, to the participation and to the processing of the registration data for running the course and granting the license.
consent.done: Thank you. The registration is now valid, a confirmation is sent by e-mail.
consent.doneWaitlist: Thank you. The course has filled up in the meantime; the registration is on the waiting list and moves up automatically when a seat becomes free.
consent.invalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Please contact the club or the course organisers.

public.title: Referee courses
public.intro: Referee courses of the state associations and Floorball Deutschland. You can register directly.
public.notFound: This course does not exist or is no longer open.
public.accountHint: Already have a referee account in Saisonmanager? Log in and use the course registration there:
public.licenseNumberHint: With a license number, the confirmation goes to the address on file with the referee department.
public.guardianHint: You are under 16 on the first course day. After your confirmation, your parents or guardians receive an e-mail and must consent before the registration is valid.
public.consent: I consent to my data being processed for running the course, invoicing and granting the license. Privacy information:
public.sentText: We have sent an e-mail with a confirmation link. The registration is only valid after you click it. If you entered a license number, the e-mail goes to the address on file. The link is valid for three days.
public.tooMany: Too many registrations from this connection. Please try again later.
public.failed: The registration did not work. Please check your details.

link.invalid: This link is invalid or has expired.

confirm.title: Confirm registration
confirm.done: Thank you, the registration is valid. A confirmation with all details is sent by e-mail.
confirm.doneWaitlist: Thank you. The course is full, the registration is on the waiting list and moves up automatically.
confirm.doneGuardian: Thank you. Your parents or guardians still need to consent; they have received an e-mail.

cancel.title: Deregister from course
cancel.late: The cancellation deadline has passed, the course fee remains due.
cancel.doneLate: You have been deregistered. As the cancellation deadline had passed, the course fee remains due.
